items.title: Irdai mandates four-tier structure for motor insurance from Dec 15
items.summary: Irdai will implement a four-tier structure for motor insurance covering private cars and two-wheelers. Customers will have the option to select separate covers, including mandatory third-party liability and optional personal accident cover. Existing policyholders can add occupant liability coverage without canceling their current policies.

items.title: Lenders accept Supreme Housing's Rs 522-crore settlement offer

The one-time settlement includes both fund and non-fund exposure from corporate guarantees given to subsidiary entities.

items.title: NBFCs redesign lending models ahead of revolving credit curbs
items.summary: Non-banking financial companies are innovating loan products to align with upcoming Reserve Bank of India guidelines. These guidelines aim to limit revolving credit facilities, prompting firms to develop term loans. Bajaj Finance has already begun launching new term loan variants, while Tata Capital is testing modified flexi-loan products. Other NBFCs are reviewing their positions on revolving credit exposure ahead of the final regulations.

items.title: Ambani's Jio Platforms explores tech-for-equity talks with Comcast and Charter, sources say
items.summary: Jio Platforms, controlled by Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries, is exploring international partnerships for its broadband technology. The company has discussed potential collaborations with Comcast, Charter Communications, and South Africa's MTN Group. Negotiations with MTN fell through due to disagreements on valuation and licensing issues. Jio aims to secure 10 to 15 global partners for its proprietary system. There is currently no set timeframe for reaching a definitive agreement.

items.title: AI boom to drive demand for clean, affordable power: Pralhad Joshi

India has been re-elected as president of the International Solar Alliance, with plans for continued investment and solar deployment.

items.title: Festive demand lifts dry fruit, chocolate imports this season

This merger combines their strengths across different markets and technologies to increase revenue and sales volume. Both companies will collaborate on electric vehicles and components, leveraging Tata's extensive distribution network.

items.title: Wockhardt seeks 14-year data shield for India-made drugs

In May this year, the company secured approvals from Indian and US drug regulators for a breakthrough drug, Zaynich (cefepime + zidebactam), to treat complicated urinary tract infection, including acute pyelonephritis or severe kidney infections. items.title: RBI eases forex rules for services exports and imports
items.summary: The changes form part of the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) which came into effect from October 1, 2026. Under the amended regulations, a resident individual exporting services will be deemed to have submitted the Export Declaration Form, or EDF, once the individual provides the authorised dealer bank with the information required to credit the payment to the exporter's account. No transaction-value threshold has been prescribed for resident individuals.
